title: NRL's 1952 appraisal of Brown's device missing

tellings.quote: When Tom Valone of the Integrity Research Institute tried to locate a copy of an appraisal of Brown's experiments conducted in 1952 by the Naval Research Laboratory, the laboratory no longer had it. The paper was called the TT Brown electrogravity device.

plain: In 1952 the Naval Research Laboratory is said to have written an appraisal of the experiments of an inventor named T. T. Brown, a paper titled "TT Brown electrogravity device", about his idea that electricity could produce a force like gravity. According to Michels, when a researcher named Tom Valone, of a group called the Integrity Research Institute, later tried to find a copy, the laboratory no longer had it. Michels tells this in his documentary on Brown as a sign that the Navy's interest in the work was quietly buried.
